## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our platform

Stat Sniper is a free app for sports bettors. It combines Chad AI's picks and predictions, a player prop tracker with sportsbook line comparison, an analytics dashboard for win rate and ROI, daily edge reports, injury news, and a social network for bettors, all in one place on iOS, Android, and web.

Chad AI reads live odds, player stats, injury reports, and matchup data across 14+ sports. It builds its own probability for each outcome, compares that to the sportsbook's line, and flags the ones where it sees an edge, with a confidence rating and the reasoning behind the call. You can ask follow-up questions, push back on the logic, and stress-test the analysis in a conversational thread.

Yes, Stat Sniper is completely free. AI picks, predictions, daily edge reports, the prop tracker, analytics dashboard, injury news, and the social feed are all included at no cost on iOS, Android, and web. An optional Pro tier adds unlimited Chad AI conversations and priority responses, but none of the core features expire or require a subscription.

Chad AI covers NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, NCAAB, NCAAF, soccer (including the World Cup, EPL, Serie A, and MLS), UFC, PFL, Formula 1, PGA Tour, and more. It handles moneylines, spreads, totals, and player props, every major bet type across every major sport.

Chad is Stat Sniper's built-in AI betting analyst. He reads real-time data (live odds from multiple sportsbooks, injury reports, matchup history, pace and efficiency metrics, and line movement) to generate confidence-rated picks with the reasoning shown. Chad supports multi-conversation threads, a thinking mode that shows his step-by-step logic, file analysis for betting slips and stat sheets, and daily game summaries.

Every Chad AI pick is logged against the final score, with accuracy broken down by sport, bet type, and confidence level. You can audit the full track record inside the app: no screenshot highlight reels, just a verifiable log of every pick and its result. The analytics dashboard shows your personal hit rate and ROI alongside Chad's performance.

Stat Sniper's prop tracker lets you browse player props across 14+ sports, compare lines across sportsbooks in a single view to find the best price, set your own predictions, and track results automatically. Every prop is graded against the actual outcome, so you can filter by sport, prop type, date, and result to see which markets give you the biggest edge.

The analytics dashboard tracks win rate, ROI, net profit, and total units, updated in real time. Break down your performance by league, prop type, and date range, track Chad's recommendations alongside your own picks, spot streaks and patterns, and use advanced filtering to find exactly where your edge lives.

Yes. Stat Sniper compares lines across major sportsbooks and prediction markets in one view. The prop tracker highlights the best available price for each prop, and Chad factors line comparison into his picks, so you always know whether you're getting the sharpest number before you bet.

Every morning, Chad scans the full slate across all supported sports and ranks the day's strongest picks before the lines move. Each one comes with a confidence rating, supporting data, and the reasoning behind the call, delivered free in the app before the action starts.

No. Stat Sniper never takes wagers or handles money on bets. It's a free analysis and social app for bettors: Chad's picks, the prop tracker, and the analytics dashboard help you make decisions, and any actual betting happens at the sportsbook of your choice.

Yes. Stat Sniper's picks marketplace lets you create subscription tiers, set your own pricing, and get paid via Stripe directly to your bank account. Your profile tracks your record, followers, and win rate, and you can earn a verified badge by building a proven track record. It's built for anyone who wants to turn their betting edge into income.

Stat Sniper is the only social network built specifically for sports bettors. It includes Personal, Following, and Discover feeds, live game-day chats with official rooms per game, private groups, DMs, and threaded comments. Share picks, debate matchups, follow sharp analysts, and build a reputation backed by your actual results.

Stat Sniper is available free on the App Store for iOS, Google Play for Android, and in any browser at app.statsniper.com. Download it and start getting Chad's picks, tracking props, and connecting with other bettors, no subscription required.
